tips: Give push and then you can trade a bit on the bounce back. Don't engage him with e before stridebreaker, bait his q1 and then when he q2 you can dash in and then aim to dodge q3 sweetspot. You outscale him so don't be sad to be behind a bit.

Give push lvl 1. Don't jump in yourself since you will get kited if she jumps into you then its probably fine since you have second wind and doran's shield sustain. You outscale big time and you can buy hexdrinker if you want to kill her. If you are 1v1 and you have q2 up and she is trying to dash away from shroud invis use attack move to knock her up while she wants to dash away so it cancels it.

Don't let him really zone you lvl 1, right on your tower range you auto-q-auto-q2 and then run away you win trade. In lane never get hit by q you might even need to e for that. If you have couple stacks up and hit w on him then go engage and you probably win. Timing your ult with his e is the biggest win in a fight but overall if you think you are gonna get ran down just go get a back off and the enemy probably messes up the wave so freeze breaks. Wave on your side is a lot easier to play. If you really are in a freeze stuck or are gonna get soon then a good trick is to bait running closer so he q-s and then click back asap so he just hits the wave and it starts pushing to you.
Against HoB cho you have to just sustain and NEVER WALK IN MEELE RANGE,hope your jungler comes to punish but be healthy enough to be useful in ganks. He is easy to gank since no dashes

Give push lvl 1. You only win full allins so don't even bother with short trades unless at your turret and you have space to run her down. If wave is at her side your only priority is getting the wave in since she will just kite under her turret every trade and the wave will get stuck there so you probably get ganked or die 1v1.

Just try to survive in this lane mostly, heal with doran's shield and second wind. Snipe minions with W and dodge with e to get some cs too, q is good for healing a bit. Lower elos where people don't know how to kite you can probably try Hail of blades and run her down and make it a lot easier.

Give push lvl 1. You lose short trades pretty heavily so all ins only, its a easier ambessa matchup. Wave at your side is gonna help a lot to run her down or just w her and then q2 e run away. You can cancel her e with q2 and w both with good timing and if you land one of them she is probably dead.

Should not really be hard to play just don't get hit by q-s and you don't really have any problems. You win all ins no problem. Wave on your side is nice to run him down but don't be without a wave since then you get chunked by q-s.
Same as aurora, try to sustain with q and just snipe minions with w and e. Killable with jg if you are healthy enough to get help.

VERY HARD lvl 1, you might even need to lose the first 3 minion xp just to not get dove lvl 2. If you get vital on you and you can block it with wall then you might even get the xp and stand your ground but overall very hard. In fights you have to wait a bit with your q2 don't use it instantly, its basically minds games when are you gonna use it etc. Your W is very goofy with her W so if you are close to her and W then its 80% it stuns but if you are far from her then W her its like 20% it stuns. All ins are a bit tricky, you need to get some stacks up and then reengage mostly (like with darius a bit).

Sustain with q and dodge barrels with e. If you hit w on your side of lane and then get barrel down you might just get a free kill. Even solokilled solarbacca a few times like that. It's fine to get hit by 2 barrel combo but getting hit by 1 is very bad.

The way to win it is just to wait for him to q and e onto you so you buffer w through his stun and then usually e-q him and then run out. This trade usually means you go even but you have more sustain so you win in the long run. All ins don't really work here if you can't g et passive stacks so don't count on that but hold wave on your side for short trades and safety to not get ran down. I build triforce here and go grasp since usually I can only get 1 Q on him so it maximises the damage. I think conqueror could be playable here too but grasp just makes it safe to go even.

Let him push into you lvl 1 and make sure you don't take a lot of damage, 1-2 attacks is fine because you have second wind and doran's shield but don't take more than 3 (especially if he has electrocute). You can mainly trade if the wave has hit your turret and you hit w and jump in and aa-q and run out. Lvl 6 you might be able to ult after that and if you cancel his e with that you probably kill him. When you get stridebreaker you most likely can fight him and try to buffer your w or ult through his e so you can stay on top of him. When he is in hammer form lvl 3 DONT ENGAGE because he has insane armor and he has so many abilities. He usually wins all ins early on because he just has so many abilities but good thing is he doesn't get lvl 6 power spike.

Lvl 1 is playable but don't run into him that's how you lose. You win allins, if you have under 90% hp then I would just chill until you get enough back to be able to stack passive up before his ult. You outscale him pretty fast but his ult is very annoying in teamfights so if you can try to avoid him or get passive stacks up before you get close to him and others.

Against a good morde you have to give prio lvl 1 and then just dodge abilities and try to scale up for teamfights where you are stronger. You can cancel his ult if you ult at the same time.In this matchup it's possible you get a solokill before 6 but killing him with jg is a lot more realistic. After lvl 6 you probably can't kill him 1v1 ever if he goes armor and ganking is pretty pointless because he oneshots your jg most of the time. Just avoid fighting him because he is a statcheck demon

You can't really contest the wave lvl 1 unless he misses all q-s. If you get hit by the q and have the option to dash away from it with e then do it. He is a very strong early game champ so try to avoid fights and since he only attacks you should rush tabis (plated steelcaps). If you are not very confident you win it then even fights early where you get passive up could be pretty bad since he basically has the same passive and in early game maybe even stronger. If you go even in this matchup then you have basically done all for your team and you deserve the win(don't mess up the important fights tho).

I never lose this matchup because you can just run around him and dodge everything but don't get too confident because he heals a lot if you get hit by the tentacle. First levels are tough but if you wait them out you should be more than fine. Make sure to avoid his e and if that ability is down you win 95% of the fights unless you are behind. Also stridebreaker giga op to dodge everything or when he ults and you are unsure its good to just run away.

If he has ap runes (comet) then doran's shield but normally go blade. You can't really contest lvl 1 but at lvl 3 you can start fighting and before lvl 6 and the first back is your main moment for a kill. It's not even that bad to take q-s early if you have doran's shield but wait for the doran's shield healing to fully come in before taking any more damage so you maximise the value. After he gets a couple components you basically don't damage him again so just shove waves and outscale him at that point. Don't mess the game up by trying to go for kills when he just statcecks you with no skill.
Just sitting under tower simulator basically, try to survive. In lower elos you can kill her maybe if you cancel her q with your ult and then hit everything.
Can play conqueror and scale but you can also try to play HoB which I think is better and just oneshot the guy before he gets 1 item and obliterates you.

Runes are up to your prefrence. Hail of blades is good if you want to really mess him up before lvl 6 but if you don't then conqueror would have been better. Lvl 1 push the wave in and then freeze on bounceback until you kill him solo or with your jg or the enemy jungle helps push the wave in. Just try to keep freezing in front of your turret while you are stronger but be very careful with his lvl 6 since he is very strong in an all in with ult and if you don't get passive stacked or run away then you are dead. In teamfights you are stronger and I will have this matchup against drututt uploaded on my main channel

Don't contest wave lvl 1 and get your lvl 3 safely. If he gets too cocky and lets you get stacks up on him on 3rd or 4th wave crash then you can look for a kill even sometimes(this is the angle where I killed most pro players) but short fights you don't really win so try to freeze the wave and then all in. You can also cancel his dashes with w and q2 so if you can do both then that should be a guaranteed kill or gets away with 1hp. Lvl 6 is his biggest powerspike so watch out for that, he is pretty op then and you have to make sure to get passive stacks up. He usually builds eclipse so his item powerspike is sooner so watch out for that and don't fight if he has item and you don't (most of the time). You usually outscale him after stridebreaker if you guys are even.

Lvl 1 don't walk up to get hit by q since he just runs you down. Try to hold the wave in front of your turret because then you can w him and do a quick trade with e and q. When wave is in front of his turret make sure to not walk up since if you get hit by a Q you are dead(especially after lvl 6). You can all in him if you have some stacks before already and you get a revive off since his ult will run out. Best way to play this matchup is just slowly poke him down while freezing wave in front of your turret but even if you are ahead be scared to just 1v1 statcheck since he has true damage and if you don't get passive or kite well you are a dead man

Just sit under tower and don't even try to fight back unless you get a gank. Just stay healthy for someone to come help you and make sure you can't be dove. He wins both short and long trades so it's basically afk lane but again you just outscale him.

Early on you stay away from him especially if he has hail of blades but at lvl 3 you can fight back a bit if he spins in. Fights you win if you get your passive revive because his ult runs out. Armor and health are good here to survive his burst and get passive up to win extended fights (against lethal tempo might be hard). You outscale him big time so going even is very good too.

Don't touch him before lvl 3 and then you might win only if you get full stacks but overall he is pretty op and you should try to avoid him before stridebreaker unless you get full stacks and run him down. Wave on your side helps with that a lot (short trades you get obliterated in).

Doran's shield is necessary because she will perma e you before lvl 6. Lvl 1 you can trade until you knock her up and after that you run since she wins it if it goes on for longer. When you get a freeze lvl 3 she can't really do anything unless you mess it up or enemy jungle helps her. If she walks up you just engage on her and easily win. After lvl 6 you can only fight her if you hit w first basically or she positions badly and don't e and w in because if you miss you lose a lot of hp. After stridebreaker it's nice to play again and you can e stridebreaker in most of the time and you should win the 1v1 unless she is ahead. You get outscaled so most games don't 1v1 her after lvl 16 but just kill others in a fight or cc her so your team gets her down.

Make sure to not die early he is pretty strong. After lvl 6 you probably have outscaled him. You can cancel his E with W and Q2 even when he is flying. You can aim your abilities on the blobs since he has to run into them or jump into them yourself so he doesn't get healing from them.

Give him push since he usually has grasp and Q healing. You can dodge his E with your E if you need but if you get hit by it and you are trying to run away then save your E for his W cage to jump out of it. You can also oneshot the cage with your Q. Usually you can't really kill him unless wave is on your side and you can run him down. Never take a lot of short trades since he has so much sustain with Q and grasp.

Don't get hit by E lvl 1 under any circumstance, after lvl 6 you insta win if you cancel his E with your ult. After black cleaver his champ is so strong 1v1 so I wouldn't fight him unless you have ult and can cancel his E. Later on you usually get outscaled in a 1v1 because his passive is so op and he stacks so much armor so play for teamfights.

This matchup is 10x better to play with hail of blades due to nimbus cloak so make sure you have that. Play safe early levels to not get poked out. Vladimir doesn't have a lot of range so after lvl 3 the moment he steps up you can usually jump in and punish him. Make sure to not let him just q you for free and especially with empowered Q. Usually you have to do 2 trades, first one you jump in and get his w and since his W cooldown is so long you jump in during the next 15 sec and punish him hard. Also don't forget that your ignite and flash give you movement speed when you have nimbus cloak so those can help you stick onto him (best ignite if you can reduce his heal and give you movement speed). After stridebreaker you should win pretty easily but later on in the game he might just outscale you.

Let her push lvl 1 and snipe minions with W, lvl 3 you can snipe her with w when she is close to your tower and if you hit it you can sometimes jump through her so she can't e you away but other than that take a quick trade and run away most of the time. If you can e in and buffer your w through her e thats your best chance at a kill or a chunk but other than that don't just jump in without a plan since you will get kited a lot. With stridebreaker this gets very easy and if you buffer your w through her e you most likely will get a kill.

You have to give prio lvl 1 probably because his W is really strong but at lvl 3 if the wave is on your side you can run him down. You can cancel his e with your Q or W so try to do that. If you succeed he is probably dead. After he gets 1-2 armor components he doesn't take damage anymore and fighting him is pointless. Make sure to not stay in lane at 50% hp if he has ult because you will get oneshot(unless you cancel his ult with your own to run away). Anyways don't force fights anymore if they are unwinnable and just outscale to kill everyone else

Usually have to give prio 1-3. You can only kill him before 1-2 components so try to get your passive up and fight him(not in a big wave tho). After that you usually don't deal damage to him and it's just afk farming after that and you kill his team later.

Give prio always and thankfully his passive pushes the wave. In this matchup you can only fight him if he doesn't have his shield or doesn't get his second W off. All long fights you lose and typically you have to just outscale and kill his team later on or most of the time they get impatient and just run it down to you under tower or make a stupid play.

Early on he is very strong but holding wave on your side is op because you can kite him and make get full stacks and then win a fight. Once he goes behind its very hard for him. His only strenght is early game so getting to scale here is very op.

Try to find her lvl 1 and then just force an all in before she gets any q stacks. If she has max stacks you insta lose any trade so give up prio if she has stacks. Playing this matchup on your side is again really good since she cant run you down.

Best way to play is just sit under turret until 20min but you can also go hail of blades and try to fight him. If you plan on fighting him then try to be full hp to get your stacks up in time. If you manage to cancel his ult with your ult then you most likely win the fight. If varus kills a minion then he gets ad and ap for couple seconds so try to wait that out. Going even here is the best you can do mostly since he is not that great in fights and he doesn't scale.

Make sure to give prio he is op early and don't fall below 70% hp under any circumstance on 3rd or 4th wave crash since he can dive you. After that you can try bait out his W with a short trade and then hit him with W and run him down and kill him. That's the most common kill angle and with stridebreaker it's gonna get a bit easier to run him down but you gotta be cautious not to get hit by max dmg W since you will most likely lose then. So the best way is to predict his stun or ult with your ult. A very advanced trick is to run so close to him and then when you think he is about E and W you, you will W him so he gets pulled through you while W-ing and then you don't take the damage.

Most of the time this would just be afking and then after stridebreaker you can kill him or during ganks but if you want to make it a bit more fun try out HOB to actually run him down. Best chance is to jump in with E if he makes a mistake and then you hit w and you have ult as well to capclose after that but Ryze has so much mobility after he W-s you so the best way usually is just to sustain and try to become stronger than him in fights. Against a good ryze you will probably have a bad time especially if you fall behind as HOB Zaahen.

This is a very bad matchup in higher elos due to getting kited perma. Get prio lvl 1 and then crash it in so it bounces back. Rumble is op after he gets lvl 3 so try to chill after that. After lvl 6 you can kill him only if you can run him down and get passive up. Overall in lane just sit to survive since rumble is a early game champ and you outscale. Early on if he overheats he just oneshots so never let him attack you while red. If you get stridebreaker and you are even then you might even win it. Most of the time I go maw here 2nd since he deals so much damage early and mid game.

Give prio his champ is the best lvl 1. You win here if you can kite him and get passive up but his champ is very op in 1v1 but if he doesn't have ult or wave to lifesteal from he is much much weaker so try to catch him like that. In bigger fights you are so much more useful. It's very hard to play from behind so try your best to go even here since then you have basically won lane. He loves to sit sidelane so just match him there and stop him from pushing.

Give lvl 1 prio and then lvl 3 you can fight her already. You can cancel her 3rd q jump with your q2 or w. Try to cancel her jump and then when she is about to stun you then buffer W. Lvl 6 make sure you don't get short traded to low hp. Allins you usually win if you block a cc with your ult. Use exhaust in this matchup if you struggle with it and you can also try out HOB and trinity force then to oneshot her.
AFK lane survive. Bad zileans can be killed with HoB

Doran's shield and second wind are a lifesaver here to survive his Q poke. Give prio and you can probably fight him after lvl 6 and if you are even when you get stridebreaker then you can perma force fights onto him and wind. To stay on him after he W-s is to buffer your W through it to pull him in and then all in. He is a early game champ so going even at the start is the best you can do.

Yasuo is the same, just make sure you are not in a position where they can run you down. Usually kill angle is lvl 3-4 on bounceback when you can run them down if they get hit by everything. Lvl 6 you win since you can cancel his ult with yours. Just don't end up in a fight without spells up.

Yone is the same(a bit worse), just make sure you are not in a position where they can run you down. Usually kill angle is lvl 3-4 on bounceback when you can run them down if they get hit by everything. Lvl 6 you win since you can even cancel the knockup with your ult. Just don't end up in a fight without spells up.
Don't fight him after he gets armor component since he doesn't take dmg and just runs away. Udyr is useless champ in teamfights so you just auto win if you don't int the lane.

You don't win any allins unless you are in a huge minion wave and he can't hit his Q or you get passive up, you could kill him if you time your ult with his ult so it doesn't work but usually its pretty hard. Usually just outscale him and in fights you are much more important.

In this matchup you basically just sit under turret, if you hit some w-s then great do a quick fight but without jg really can't look for a kill. If the kennen is bad you might be able to kill him by ulting right as he is about to stun you so it doesn't work. After stridebreaker it's a lot nicer to play and you usually outscale him if you are not that behind. Don't be scared to go behind in cs tho since xp is more important.

If you hit your w under your turret and he has no e then you might just get a kill by running him down the lane. With ghost it's very simple but I don't play it anymore since best gnar's really don't make those mistakes anymore. Master and below I think nobody knows how to play gnar so I recommend HoB with ignite or conqueror with ghost. Lane gets a lot easier with stridebreaker, if you whiff your w in lane be prepared to lose 40% of your hp minimum. Play around the bushes so he can't attack you there. If he places a ward you can aa-q and it's gone.

If you play this below grandmaster you can try take ghost to run her down after she has used her ghost/exhaust but other than that this is just afking under turret for 20min simulator against a good player and you don't even outscale so best of luck if your jg doesn't gank her. Hail of blades probably good against bad vayne players so I recommend that because conqueror is just so boring and you have to count on your team to carry you.
I think he doesn't have that much range so it should be fine if you land w and then jump on him and run him down. Block his e so he cant run away.

Basically a sustain battle so grasp is playable here but I don't play it. You can buffer W through his e and then run him down sometimes or get a good chunk of his hp. Don't jump into him with e since you will just get full comboed instantly(do it after he has used e already to trade back). Try to hold the wave on your side so it's possible to gank him and having the wave on your side means you wont get ultied under his turret or cc chained to death and jg bursts you down in a gank. Overall pretty afk matchup just dodge barrels and heal spam q to heal.

Just sit under tower and outscale the guy. It's a useless champion after master and your job is just to get as much farm as possible while not interacting with the guy and trying to keep health high so maybe you can kill him with your jg.

If you can then don't let her stack her q but don't over force it either by walking into her wave since you will instantly lose it. You can e to the side when she tries to q and e you and then you win the trade but watch out for the all in. You have to play well and hit everything to kill her otherwise she kills you before you get passive up. A lot easier to play this matchup on your side again and she is very gankable.

Don't fight for push because he just gets it from you easily and you will be frozen on. Usually when the wave is frozen on your side you can all in lvl 3-4 and if you stack up passive you win (make sure you don't engage into a big wave). You can kill him a couple times early but once he gets a couple armor components then don't even try to fight him since even if you dodge everything you won't deal damage. At that point just clear waves and scale since you will be 5x more useful than him. Don't throw the game because you want to fight him.

Who plays this? You probably win allins after lvl 3 but one way he can do it if he kites with his jump and lets your passive run out but I don't know I think I have faced this once and wasn't that bad. Just don't let him jump onto you and root and run away.

Let her push into you at the start and then maybe on the bouneback you can trade and maybe kill her but if she gets a couple components she is very broken. If she is stronger than you in lane then don't even try to fight just cs. After you get stridebreaker you should be able to win extended fights(if you are even) and you probably outscaled her.
